_provenance.note: LLM reading of the lens token tables; not a measurement

axes.label: profane anger/disgust ↔ calm narrative connectives
axes.rationale: The Jacobian lens negative end is profanity and disgust ('fucking', 'damn', 'shit', 'nausea'), with ' bile' appearing in the tuned lens, while its positive end and the real-logit positives are discourse continuations (' BUT', ' THEN', ' Later', ' However', ' Soon'); the logit and tuned lenses are mostly fragments.

axes.label: indignant outrage ↔ wistful melancholy
axes.rationale: At the positive end, the Jacobian lens gives ' loneliness', ' sadness', ' memories', ' nights' and ' Suddenly', with suddenly-tokens echoed in the logit and tuned lenses and ' Life', ' Winter', ' Finally' in the real-logit correlation; the negative end has ' outraged', ' WTF', ' obviously', ' apparently' (Jacobian) matching ' Obviously', ' Clearly', ' Furious' (real-logit).

axes.label: fear/panic ↔ pleasant everyday contentment
axes.rationale: The Jacobian, logit and tuned lenses all put fear tokens at the negative end (' terrified', ' panic', ' fear', ' страх'), and the real-logit correlation adds ' Fear'; the positive end has ' nice', ' happy', ' yummy', ' usually' (Jacobian) and ' Sometimes', ' Usually', ' Good' (real-logit).
